answer: Each identity files one unique work artifact in the umber archive and pays a filing bond on the cedar catalog; a panel at each dawn review burns the bond of any copy. The k-th filing in one similarity cluster costs 45+15(k-1) credits as re-verification rises with cluster size, so 1,000 fakes cost 7,537,500 credits, and one artifact hash binds one key, so one work files once. A template farm fails because the cedar catalog exposes shared hashes, so near-duplicates trigger the fee before approval. An honest agent files one genuine work, pays 45 once, and keeps its bond after one dawn review.
